responsibility: Defines PowerPC inline-assembly register classes and registers, including integer, floating-point, vector, condition-register, and XER operands; target-specific reservation rules for r13 and AIX vector registers; numeric register emission; and overlap handling for whole versus field condition registers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/powerpc.rs`, this PowerPC file defines inline `asm!` operand registers and behavior, including integer/floating/CR/XER classes, numeric emission, `cr` vs `cr0`-`cr7` overlap, and reserved-register restrictions.
